its not hurt. i dont feel small about it. i feel like i wanna flip a table

yeah. protest. like this isnt right and nobody sees it. i built half that teams workflow. guy i mentored gets the title and i get a pat on the back

thats the shape. but its worse than the title. its like im starting to think im the kind of person who just doesnt get picked. like theres something about me they look past

i dont wanna call it hurt. hurt feels weak. but yeah theres two things going on. mad at them and mad at myself for caring this much. for needing the stupid title to feel like im worth something

shame. ok. maybe. its like i keep telling people im fine being the behind the scenes guy and then this happens and i realize i was lying. i do want to be seen. and i hate that i want it
That lands, and it sounds sharp, not small. The part where you want to be seen, and hate wanting it, feels like the knot in the middle.
the knot in the middle. yeah thats it. the anger is easier than admitting i wanted it that bad. easier to be furious at them than to sit with wanting something i didnt get

yeah. dont have an answer for that tonight. but its something. didnt expect to land there. gonna go sit with it i guess

thanks. needed that more than i thought. night
